question: The marked price of an article is Rs. 5,450. If a person earns a profit of 15% after allowing a discount of 15%, then the cost price (in Rs) (correct to the nearest integer) of the article is:
solution:
**Given-** The marked price of an article is= 5450

Discount= 15% and Profit= 15%

**Calculation-**

⇒ The selling price of an article will be- (5450times 85)/(100) = (545×17)/(2)

⇒ Let the CP will be 100x and the selling obtain on the profit will be 115x as 15% profit is given.

⇒ 115x= (545×17)/(2)

⇒ x= (545×17)/(230)

Hence, the value of 100x i.e. CP will be= (545×10×17)/(23)= (92650)/(23)= 4028.26

Hence, the cost price of the article is= **4028**
